description: Retrieves a credit balance transaction by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get details about a specific credit or debit transaction against a credit grant.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a credit balance transaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the credit balance transaction object. Typically starts with 'cbtxn_'.
id.title: Id

inputSchema.title: GetBillingCreditBalanceTransactionsIdRequest

name: get_billing_credit_balance_transactions_id

AmountDetails.description: Amount details for credit or debit transactions.

type.description: The type of amount. Currently supports 'monetary'.
type.title: Type

AmountDetails.title: AmountDetails

credits_application_invoice_voided.description: Details when an invoice voiding resulted in credit.
credits_application_invoice_voided.title: Credits Application Invoice Voided

CreditsApplicationInvoiceVoided.description: Details when credits are voided from an invoice application.

invoice_line_item.description: The original invoice line item identifier.

CreditsApplicationInvoiceVoided.title: CreditsApplicationInvoiceVoided

invoice_line_item.description: The invoice line item identifier where credits were applied.

CreditsApplied.title: CreditsApplied

credits_applied.description: Details when credits were applied to an invoice.
credits_applied.title: Credits Applied

GetBillingCreditBalanceTransactionsIdRes.description: Response model containing credit balance transaction details.

created.description: Time at which the object was created, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

credit.description: Credit details. Present only when type is 'credit'.

debit.description: Debit details. Present only when type is 'debit'.
debit.title: Debit

effective_at.description: Unix timestamp when the transaction became effective.
effective_at.title: Effective At

id.title: Id

livemode.description: Indicates whether the object exists in live mode (true) or test mode (false).
livemode.title: Livemode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'billing.credit_balance_transaction'.

test_clock.description: ID of the test clock associated with this transaction, if applicable.
